# Turbo C++ Online (TC / Turbo C Plush)

> Free, in-browser Borland Turbo C++ 3.2 compiler and IDE powered by WebAssembly DOSBox. Zero installation required. 100% ad-free.

- **Website**: https://turbocplus.vercel.app/
- **Author**: Arth (https://github.com/ArthOfficial)
- **Primary Keywords**: turbo c, turboc, turboc++, turbo c plus, turbo c plus online, turbo c plush, turbo-c, turbo-c online, online-c, online c compiler, online c++ compiler, online c ide, turbo c online, turbo c compiler, run turbo c in browser, c compiler online, tc online, turboc3 online
- **Pages**:
  - Compiler IDE: https://turbocplus.vercel.app/
  - Shortcuts Cheat-sheet: https://turbocplus.vercel.app/shortcuts.html
  - Frequently Asked Questions: https://turbocplus.vercel.app/faq.html
  - Documentation & DOS API: https://turbocplus.vercel.app/docs.html

## Overview
Turbo C++ Online provides a browser-based emulation of Borland Turbo C++ 3.2 running on DOSBox via JS-DOS and WebAssembly. It enables students, educators, and retro computing enthusiasts to write, compile, debug, and run C and C++ programs directly within any modern web browser without downloading 16-bit emulation software or dealing with OS incompatibilities on modern 64-bit systems like Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS, and Linux.

## Core Capabilities
- **Instant Live Code Injection**: Inject external C/C++ source code directly into `TURBOC3/BIN/CODE.CPP` within 0.3 seconds using direct virtual filesystem manipulation, avoiding keyboard buffer loss.
- **Native File Import**: Drag and drop or upload local `.CPP`, `.C`, `.H`, or `.TXT` files from the host operating system.
- **Full DOS & C++ Support**: Complete support for standard Turbo C++ libraries including `iostream.h`, `stdio.h`, `conio.h` (`clrscr()`, `getch()`), and `graphics.h` (EGA/VGA modes).
- **Unrestricted Pointer Navigation**: Standard mouse capture is disabled so users can seamlessly switch between the IDE menus and other application windows.
- **100% Ad-Free**: No third-party advertisements, tracking scripts, or promotional popups.

## Keyboard Shortcuts
- `Shift + Insert` or `Ctrl + Shift + V`: Open Code Insertion / Paste Modal
- `F3`: Open file dialog inside Turbo C++
- `F2`: Save current file
- `Ctrl + F9`: Compile and Run program
- `Alt + F5`: Switch to DOS User Screen to view output
- `Alt + X`: Exit Turbo C++
- `F7` / `F8`: Step trace / Step over
- `Alt + F9`: Compile source without running

## Technical Specifications
- Emulation Core: JS-DOS 8.4.1 (WebAssembly DOSBox)
- Default Target: 16-bit Real Mode x86
- Standard Architecture: C++ by default (.CPP), with full backwards C compatibility (.C)
- Host Requirements: Any modern browser with WebAssembly support (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
